Allowed origins (worker/src/index.ts:19-31): the `cors()` middleware's `origin` callback permits exactly `http://localhost:4200`, any `*.pages.dev` subdomain, and any `*.workers.dev` subdomain (all others get `null`/rejected).

**To add a new custom domain**, edit that `origin` function in `worker/src/index.ts` (lines 21-30) — add another condition, e.g. `origin === 'https://your-custom-domain.com'` or `origin.endsWith('.your-custom-domain.com')`, inside the `if (...)` block before `return origin;`. Array entries won't work for wildcards per Hono's matching (see `docs/DEPLOYMENT_NOTES.md#4-cors`).
